subject: English
title: CBSE English, Class VII

source.read: Directorate of Education, Delhi: Class VII English annual syllabus 2026-27, built on the NCERT textbook Poorvi (NCF-SE 2023) that CBSE schools use
source.note: UNOFFICIAL SOURCE. CBSE does not publish a line-by-line English syllabus below Class 9; this list follows a state education department's year plan for the NCERT book Poorvi, read through a text summary of the PDF. Chapters are named by kind, not reproduced.

licence: Strand names as printed (facts). Every outcome is written by OpenPath in its own words; no curriculum or textbook text is reproduced.
review: OpenPath curriculum inventory (AI-assisted research from secondary sources; not an educator review)

outcomes.text: Listens for details: matches speakers, marks true or false, completes tables.
Marks a route on a map from directions heard.
outcomes.note: Directions are read and followed on a map; heard directions are not.

outcomes.text: Gives a one-minute speech and narrates an experience.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Takes part in role plays, group discussions and debates.
outcomes.note: Done aloud with a grown-up, who ticks what they heard. The app cannot hear or mark speaking.

outcomes.text: Reads stories, poems and biographies for meaning and character.
Notices simile, metaphor, personification, hyperbole and imagery.
outcomes.note: Poems are read with questions on figurative language; each device is also practised in Grammar in use.

outcomes.text: Writes descriptive and creative paragraphs, and a short story.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Writes formal and informal letters, an application and a notice.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Writes a diary entry, a dialogue and short poems.
outcomes.note: Written here or on paper to a task set for this class. The learner checks it against a short list and a grown-up ticks what they see. The app does not keep or mark the writing; the essay studio gives a closer analysis where an evaluator is connected.

outcomes.text: Uses present perfect and its continuous, and the past perfect.
Uses used to and would for past habits, and modals.
Makes the verb agree with its subject, and uses articles.
Uses main and subordinate clauses, and reported speech.
Uses phrasal verbs, prefixes, suffixes and compound words.
Uses the four kinds of sentence, colons and semicolons.
